resources.string: Keep your place on both devices
NeoSync carries your reading place between Neo Reader on this Boox and CrossPoint on your Picco.
You read here in Neo Reader. NeoSync notices each page turn and saves your reading place online.
The Picco doesn’t sync by itself. Open the same book there and choose Sync Progress: it jumps to where you stopped.
It works the other way too: after reading on the Picco, choose Sync Progress again, and Neo Reader opens at the new place.
Accurate to about a page. Your notes and highlights stay in Neo Reader; only the reading place is synced.
The firmware the Picco ships with has no progress sync. You first need to install CrossPoint, a free open-source firmware, on the Picco.
On a computer, open crosspointreader.com and follow the instructions for the Boox Picco.
The Picco is flashed over USB. It takes a few minutes.

Before you flash: Boox does not support custom firmware and says installing it may void your warranty. Some units may be locked. This is your decision; NeoSync is not affiliated with Boox or CrossPoint.
Turn on sync on the Picco
On the Picco, open Settings → Connectivity → CrossPoint Sync.
Leave the server address empty. That uses CrossPoint’s free sync server, the same one NeoSync uses.
Choose Sign Up to create your account, or create it here in NeoSync in a moment. Use the same username and password on both devices.
Sync Behavior: once you start a sync, “Smart sync” picks the device that is ahead. “Ask every time” lets you pick Apply Remote or Upload Local.
The Picco only syncs when you ask: open the book, press Confirm, then choose Sync Progress. To hold Confirm instead, set Settings → Controls → Front buttons → Menu long press to CrossPoint Sync.
NeoSync recognises a book by its file name. Put the same EPUB on both devices, with exactly the same file name.
Copy the file to both devices without renaming it. A renamed copy is treated as a different book.
Use EPUB files. Reading places in EPUBs are matched by chapter and are the most accurate.
Before fetching a reading place from the Picco, close the book in Neo Reader. A book that is open on screen can’t be moved.
Let NeoSync work in the background
NeoSync asks for two permissions, and Boox needs to be told not to stop it.

Optional, and books never leave your devices. NeoSync reads your book files to: find each EPUB’s chapters, so reading places are exact; show covers; send books to the Picco over your Wi-Fi; and, if you choose “by file contents” matching, fingerprint a book. It changes a book only when you tap Fix missing covers, and first keeps the original in Books/.neosync-backup. Without this access, sync still works by file name.
A small permanent notification keeps sync running.
If the NeoSync icon is greyed out, long-press it and choose Unfreeze.
In Settings → Apps → NeoSync, allow it to run in the background and to start automatically.
Use the same account as on your Picco. No account yet? Choose a username and password and tap Create account.
